help.purpose: Launch the managed Claude Code connection through the published three-slot snapshot.
help.arguments_and_options: --agent claude-code and --context <CONTEXT_ID> are required, followed by the exact -- delimiter. Session arguments after -- are passed as native OsString values. The last --settings object or file supplies the managed overlay, matching native repeated-option precedence (unrelated fields survive; routing, authentication, and provider entries stay managed). --model, --setting-sources, and --fallback-model pass through unchanged. Cloud-provider, authentication, and routing override arguments are rejected before Local Control access or spawn.
help.effects: Creates one owner-only temporary launch overlay, directly spawns the exact managed Agent executable without a shell, and removes the overlay after child exit; no persistent user configuration is changed.
help.network_and_model_use: Local Control supplies a non-secret descriptor. The launched Claude process may send caller-requested model traffic only through the numeric-loopback HiRoute Gateway.
help.automation: Treat the exact -- delimiter as the child argv boundary. Before-spawn failures are typed machine envelopes; after spawn, consume the child streams and exit status directly.
help.output: On successful spawn, stdout and stderr are the launched Agent streams; the non-secret launch descriptor is not printed. Failures before spawn emit one hiroute.machine-envelope/v2 JSON object on stdout.
help.exit_status: Returns the launched Agent exit code, or 128 plus its terminating Unix signal. Before spawn: 2 usage; 3 auth/routing conflict; 5 connection not found; 6 unavailable. Launcher lifecycle failures return 6.
